'''Carl Weber''' (born 1964) is an American author, publisher, television writer and producer. He owns [[Urban Books]], a publishing company, and formerly owned Urban Knowledge, a chain of bookstores.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.toledoblade.com/a-e/books/2010/04/18/Carl-Weber-knows-business-of-romance/stories/201004180067|title=Carl Weber knows business of romance|website=Toledo Blade|language=en|access-date=April 19, 2020}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://eurweb.com/2015/02/14/carl-weber-prolific-urban-writer-and-publisher-releases-new-novel/|title=Carl Weber: Prolific Urban Writer and Publisher Releases New Novel|last=Jack|first=Fisher|date=February 14, 2015|website=EURweb|language=en-US|access-date=April 19, 2020}}</ref> His mystery novels were adapted into films ''[[The Man in 3B]]'' (2015), ''The Preacher's Son'' (2017), ''The Choir Director'' (2018) and ''[[Carl Weber's Influence|Influence]]'' (2020). Weber created and produced the crime family drama series ''[[The Family Business (American TV series)|The Family Business]]'' (2018–present) based on his book series. In 2022, he created the crime drama series ''[[The Black Hamptons]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://deadline.com/2022/03/carl-weber-the-black-hamptons-bet-series-1234974973/|title='Carl Weber's The Black Hamptons' Limited Series Set For BET Bow|first=Bruce|last=Haring|date=March 10, 2022}}</ref>

==Life and career==
Weber is from [[Jamaica, Queens|Jamaica, Queens, New York]].<ref name=":0" /> He attended [[Virginia State University]], where he received a B.S., and the [[University of Virginia]], where he received an MBA.<ref>Gale Literature: ''Contemporary Authors''. Updated February 3, 2011.</ref><ref>{{Cite magazine |first=Felicia |last=Pride  |title=King Carl: Publisher, bookseller, novelist, family man and—oh, yeah—ladies' man |magazine=[[Publishers Weekly]] |date=2006-01-06 |volume=253 |issue=2 |url=https://www.publishersweekly.com/pw/print/20060109/6396-king-carl.html |url-access=subscription |access-date=2020-04-19 |quote=...Urban Books, the publishing company he started in 2002... |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170110020358/https://www.publishersweekly.com/pw/print/20060109/6396-king-carl.html |archive-date=2017-01-10 |url-status=live}}</ref>

He published his first book, ''Lookin' for Luv'', in 2000. ''Man on the Run'' was a ''[[Library Journal]]'' pick of the month;<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.libraryjournal.com/?detailStory=fan-favorites-and-promising-newcomers-african-american-fiction-and-more|title=Fan Favorites and Promising Newcomers {{!}} African American Fiction (and More)|last=Welch|first=Rollie|website=Library Journal|access-date=April 19, 2020}}</ref> ''So You Call Yourself a Man'' was a ''Library Journal'' bestseller.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.libraryjournal.com/?detailStory=lj-bestsellers-38|title=LJ Bestsellers|date=May 21, 2010|website=Library Journal|access-date=April 19, 2020}}</ref>

His ''The Family Business'' series was made into [[List of programs broadcast by BET|a television series]] on [[BET]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.broadwayworld.com/bwwtv/article/BET-Acquires-CARL-WEBERS-THE-FAMILY-BUSINESS-20181109|title=BET Acquires CARL WEBER'S THE FAMILY BUSINESS|website=BroadwayWorld.com|language=en|access-date=April 19, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://lasentinel.net/ernie-hudson-steps-in-as-the-patriarch-of-a-family-empire-in-carl-webers-the-family-business-playing-on-bet-networks.html|title=Ernie Hudson Steps In As The Patriarch Of A Family Empire In "Carl Weber's The Family Business," Playing On BET Networks|date=December 6, 2018|website=Los Angeles Sentinel|language=en-US|access-date=April 19, 2020}}</ref> The first season aired in 2018.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://deadline.com/2017/07/ernie-hudson-the-family-business-movie-carl-weber-novel-1202126567/|title=Ernie Hudson Headlines 'The Family Business' Based On Carl Weber Novel|last=Busch|first=Anita|date=July 11, 2017|website=Deadline|language=en|access-date=April 19, 2020}}</ref> A second season set to air in 2020 was announced in 2019.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://deadline.com/2019/12/carl-webers-the-family-business-renewed-season-2-bet-plus-1202814097/|title=Carl Weber's 'The Family Business' Renewed For Season 2 By BET+|last=Petski|first=Denise|date=December 19, 2019|website=Deadline|language=en|access-date=April 19, 2020}}</ref> Weber's novel ''Influence'' was adapted for BET Plus.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.blackfilm.com/read/2020/02/exclusive-deborah-cox-talks-bet-plus-original-film-carl-webers-influence/|title=Exclusive: Deborah Cox Talks BET Plus Original Film "Carl Weber's Influence"|last=Morales|first=Wilson|date=February 19, 2020 |website=blackfilm.com |access-date=April 19, 2020}}</ref>
